notes:
A formal term for deliberately hiding or concealing information. Frequently appears in legal, journalistic, and corporate governance contexts. Often implies wrongdoing when information that should be disclosed is hidden, but can also describe legitimate confidentiality measures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{秘匿|ひとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to conceal evidence
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘匿|ひとく}: concealment of information
- {秘匿|ひとく}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: duty of confidentiality
- {秘匿|ひとく}{性|せい}: secrecy, confidentiality
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{秘匿|ひとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to conceal facts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隠蔽|いんぺい}→隠蔽：07627_inpei⟧: cover-up — strongly implies wrongful concealment with intent to deceive
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧: classified, confidential — refers to the classified status of information itself
- ⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide — the everyday general word; can be used for anything from physical hiding to secrets

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in legal documents, news reports, and official communications.
